__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="pvme-style-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>PvME Style Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Consistency makes guides easier to read and maintain. This guide covers formatting, structure, and PvME-specific conventions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="sections-templates"><ins><nowiki>Sections &amp; Templates</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We have various types of guides, each of which has a unique structure and sections within</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Most templates you will require can be found on the </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/guide-editor/ <nowiki>Guide Editor</nowiki>]<nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/By04eu9tkH.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="language-formatting"><ins><nowiki>Language &amp; Formatting</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use UK English (e.g. armour, not armour; defence, not defense)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Date format: 22nd July 2013</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do not end lines with blank space (this is referred to as &quot;trailing whitespace&quot;)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="styling-punctuation"><ins><nowiki>Styling &amp; Punctuation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Always end full sentences with a full stop / period</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Exceptions:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• bullet points should </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> end in a full stop</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any sentence ending in an emoji should </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> end in a full stop 🚀</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Text styles:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>**Bold**</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎– Key items or emphases</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>*Italic*</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎– Inline notes or footnotes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>__Underline__</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎– Optional emphasis</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="emojis"><ins><nowiki>Emojis</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spacing</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Emojis require a space before </nowiki><strong><nowiki>and</nowiki></strong><nowiki> after:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>❌ Detonate&lt;:deto:123&gt; is a spell.
❌ Spellbook Swap &lt;:SBS:543875425055670275&gt;is a spell.
✅ Spellbook Swap &lt;:SBS:543875425055670275&gt; is a spell.
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are a few </nowiki><strong><nowiki>exceptions</nowiki></strong><nowiki> where spaces are not needed:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Letter prefixes (</nowiki><code><nowiki>r</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>s</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>_</nowiki></code><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Punctuation/backslash/backtick prefixes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trailing punctuation or underscore</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inside backticks (embeds)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Invisible characters</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allowed examples:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>r&lt;:emoji:1&gt; &lt;:emoji:7&gt;. &quot;… &lt;:emoji:4&gt; …&quot; &lt;:emoji:7&gt;! `…&lt;:emoji:11&gt;…` &lt;emoji:73&gt;\n\u00a0
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="notes"><ins><nowiki>Notes</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use sparingly to highlight key info</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Put notes </nowiki><em><nowiki>below</nowiki></em><nowiki> their related content</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For a single note, show it in-line and italic:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>*Note: This is a note.*
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For multiple notes, show as bullets and italic:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>*Notes:*
⬥ *This is a note*
⬥ *This is another note*
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="headings"><ins><nowiki>Headings</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Headings represent sections and sub-sections</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Always put a </nowiki><code><nowiki>.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎on the line before any heading (ignore the backslash </nowiki><code><nowiki>\</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎in the below example)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>&lt;End of previous section&gt;

\.
## __Section 2__
This is the new section
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>#</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and underline the title</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>##</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎/ </nowiki><code><nowiki>###</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and underline level 1 and 2 headings</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Level 3 headings:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Discord doesn't allow </nowiki><code><nowiki>####</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for level 3 headings</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore remove the underline to distinguish</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre># Title
## __Section 1__
### __Sub-section 1.1__
### Sub-sub-section 1.1.1

## __Section 2__

## __Section 3__
### __Sub-section 3.1__
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Headings should be capitalised following the Oxford style:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><nowiki>✅ Capitalise
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ First and last word
⬥ Nouns
⬥ Pronouns
⬥ Verbs
⬥ Adjectives
⬥ Adverbs
⬥ Any word over four letters
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><nowiki>❌ Don’t capitalise
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Articles (a, an, the)
⬥ Prepositions (to, on, in, for, with, etc.)
⬥ Conjunctions (and, but, or, nor, etc.)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="lists"><ins><nowiki>Lists</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Bulleted lists use different characters depending on the level</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 2 bullets should be indented 4 spaces</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Level 3 bullets should be indented 8 spaces</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1) Numbered Lists follow the same rules with indentation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a) Level 2 should use letters</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Level 3 should be bullets</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Where visually dense, you may add line breaks between list items (like above this bullet)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="links-and-embedded-content"><ins><nowiki>Links and Embedded Content</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Only use content from </nowiki><code><nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>https://img.pvme.io/</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(via </nowiki><span><nowiki>#guide-media-upload-and-request</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Add angled brackets </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎around links to prevent them showing inline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example, </nowiki><code><nowiki>[Greater Fury](&lt;https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Fury&gt;)</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-markdown-github-syntax"><ins><nowiki>Useful Markdown &amp; GitHub Syntax</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>‎`code` ‎</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for inline code</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>.img:&lt;url&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for images</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>.tag:sectionName</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for ToC section targets</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>$linkmsg_sectionName$</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for linking to that section</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="filenames"><ins><nowiki>Filenames</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Filenames should follow these naming patterns:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic guides: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{bossName}-basic.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combat Achievements: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{bossName}-ca.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commands: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{commandName}.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DPM Advice: </nowiki><code><nowiki>dpm-advice-{style}.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One-tick guides: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{bossName}-one-tick.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Full Boss guides: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{bossName}-{difficulty}-{style}.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><code><nowiki>{difficulty}</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎is optional; either </nowiki><code><nowiki>hm</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>nm</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><code><nowiki>{style}</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎is optional; either </nowiki><code><nowiki>ranged</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>magic</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>melee</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>necromancy</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>hybrid</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Slayer: </nowiki><code><nowiki>{monsterName}.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If not listed above, hyphenate the title:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g., </nowiki><code><nowiki>interface-guide.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These naming patterns should also apply if the file is inside the boss folder, e.g. </nowiki><code><nowiki>/sanctum/sanctum-hm-ranged.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets"><ins><nowiki>Presets</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Create and link to presets in our Preset Maker tool (</nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Multiple presets may be created for different situations</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Links to presets should be in the following pattern:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>{Combat style} - {Basic/Advanced/Tier}</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g., </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/editor-resources/editor-references/style-guide/# <nowiki>Necromancy - Basic</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/editor-resources/editor-references/style-guide/# <nowiki>Necromancy - T95/100</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only the last link should be shown - the rest should be hidden by wrapping the link in </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g., </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=presetID <nowiki>https://presets.pvme.io?id=presetID</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avoid dyed gear or overpriced items which do not feature in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Be consistent with:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rune pouch colours (</nowiki><span><nowiki>#armour-and-weapons</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• EoF emojis (</nowiki><span><nowiki>#eof-specs</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="using-notes-in-presets"><ins><nowiki>Using Notes in Presets</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Notes relating to specific preset gear/items should be added to the Preset Maker</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not add notes to the guide, for example below the Preset image</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Add a note for any non-standard gear or niche items</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Add a note on any gear where perks differ from standard ones listed in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For AFK guides, notes may be added to the </nowiki><code><nowiki>Mandatory AFK Requirements</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎embed for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required ability unlocks (including </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Talent Tree)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mandatory gear/items differing from those listed in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotations"><ins><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki>[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-settings/master/emojis/emojis.json <nowiki>full emoji codes</nowiki>]<nowiki>, e.g., </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;:emoji:ID&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>+</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎to combine same-tick actions, e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>→</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎to separate ticks and GCDs, e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>()</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target cycle (tc)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto attacks (auto)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Waiting (2t) - ticks are from previous action</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Channel durations (3 hit)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon types (DW) / (2H)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Autocasting (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Include non-ability actions, e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayer" title="dragonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1" alt="demonslayer" title="demonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336877900890135.png?v=1" alt="nip" title="nip" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>s</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and </nowiki><code><nowiki>r</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎to represent stall &amp; release, e.g.:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>s&lt;ability&gt; → r&lt;ability&gt; + &lt;nextability&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> properly, e.g.:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon specs: </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;:sgb&gt; &lt;:spec&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• EOF specs: </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;:sgb&gt; &lt;:eofspec&gt;</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Show ammo swaps before and after abilities, e.g.:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Single ammo switch: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Includes off-style abilities: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1" alt="hydrixbakri" title="hydrixbakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple ammo switch (like &quot;wensporing&quot;): </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrow" title="wenarrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 0-tick abilities should follow this pattern:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (0tick)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Add a note pointing to the </nowiki><code><nowiki>!0tick</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎command</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="table-of-contents-toc"><ins><nowiki>Table of Contents (ToC)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each guide ends with a pinned ToC section</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ ToC is always within a Discord embed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Must be pinned – add </nowiki><code><nowiki>.pin:delete</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎under it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The easiest way to create a ToC is to add a </nowiki><code><nowiki>.tag:</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎after all relevant headings, then auto-generate your ToC using the </nowiki><code><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎feature on the </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/guide-editor/ <nowiki>Guide Editor</nowiki>]<nowiki> (see image below)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using this method, you should check the words displayed as they may be abbreviated</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mhO3jajZIa.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Example:</nowiki></p>
